title: Use uploaded image as new logo and update contact phone number to 7019071669

requirements.text: Add the user-uploaded logo image to the frontend as a static asset and update all logo usages so the site header and footer display the new uploaded logo instead of the current generated logo asset.

quotes: Yes, use this as the new logo OR

acceptanceCriteria: A new logo image file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated (or equivalent public static assets location) derived from the uploaded image.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx no longer references /assets/generated/legend-techno-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png and instead references the new uploaded-logo asset.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx no longer references /assets/generated/legend-techno-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png and instead references the new uploaded-logo asset.
The logo renders correctly (not stretched) in both header and footer on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Update the site’s displayed contact phone number to 7019071669 wherever a phone number is shown in the UI (including the Contact section’s Contact Information card).
acceptanceCriteria: The phone number displayed in frontend/src/components/sections/ContactSection.tsx is updated from the placeholder number to 7019071669.
No other UI location continues to display the old placeholder phone number (+1 (555) 123-4567).
The phone number is formatted consistently (plain digits or a readable format) and is legible in both light and dark themes.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources must be composed, not modified).
Do not modify immutable hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Do not change backend (Motoko) functionality or inquiry storage APIs for this request.
Do not redesign the overall site layout/theme beyond what is necessary to swap the logo and update the phone number.
Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).

edits: Replace the existing logo image with the uploaded logo artwork (legend-techno-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png > legend-techno-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png)
